data.observations: Exact baseline: sentinel PASS and both adapters ACCEPT. The first (d01), middle (d06), and last (d12) theorem-value replacements each used Sort 0 in place of a proof of True. All six malformed cells were rejected with exit 1, and the sentinel flagged all three changed artifacts. Official diagnostics identify the corresponding declaration type mismatch. Lean4Lean also reports the mismatch but panics while pretty-printing the error; its checker did not accept the bad artifact.
data.limitations: Finite retained twelve-theorem chain, one malformed-value mechanism, two bound adapters. Sentinel classifications group identity/dependency failures and are not kernel verdicts. Lean4Lean error-formatting panic is an incidental diagnostic issue, not evidence of accepting an invalid proof. The initial sandbox attempt failed /bin/ps memory-backend preflight before checker launch and was preserved; host retry completed all cells. No broader checker correctness or completeness follows.
data.decision: NO_SIGNAL for missed invalid-target detection in this declared sample. Retain the three position fixtures and raw diagnostics. No confirmation of an acceptance defect follows; assess the Lean4Lean error-formatting panic separately only if diagnostic robustness becomes a scoped priority.
data.cost: 8 supervised checker launches; 1 sandbox prelaunch failure with zero checker launches; 1 host retry; summed supervised checker elapsed 1.747877 s; all 8 had positive RSS samples and cleanup complete. Model token/cost attribution is deferred to campaign handoff.
